items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: So the guys that admire the Oliver band and Louie's Hot Fives and Sevens don't care for George Lewis

ctx.x: And there's really a distinguishing part. Like, that's the criticism that I hear so many of us. So the guys that admire the Oliver band and Louie's Hot Fives and Sevens don't care for George Lewis, because, well, I said, those were their interpretation of the real Rollins guys, and when the other bands are lacking changes and stuff, they're criticizing tremendously. Of course, I'm always fighting that battle up there, too, but that's another story. But that's where the harmonies work in. And yet, you take a…
